blocks.text: In a fictional workshop, an atlas showed its first route only when a lantern crossed the paper.
Moving the lantern revealed a second invented path. This passage gives the Reader a distinct progress anchor after purchase.
The linked reference is deliberately synthetic; it is not evidence for a real-world claim.
